what: `emit_json_child_steps` interval pass-through is ambiguous: parent `start`/`end` params share names with loop-local child bounds
scenario_or_breakage: An implementer may pass the parent implement-window `start,end` into `emit_json_step` instead of the child mark interval; `emit_round_array` matches only on `round_skill` and `round_start`, so design `round` rows from an earlier child mark in the same parent slice can attach to a later per_step entry (e.g. second `design Step 3 — plan review` after Gate-C re-entry, or another design sub-step under the same implement step)
suggested_fix: State explicitly that the `emit_json_step(..., s, e)` call inside `emit_json_child_steps` must use the loop-local child `s` and capped `e` from `skill_mark_ts` / `skill_interval_end` (current lines 374-377), not the function’s parent-window `start`/`end` parameters; add a fixture with two same-label design marks and disjoint round rows to `scripts/test-timing-report.sh`
